title: Blockbuster - PlayStation 2 - PS2 - MLB 06 The Show - Tested and Working
descriptionText:
Experience the thrill of America's favorite pastime with this PS2 game, featuring the 2006 MLB The Show franchise. This unit includes the game manual and multiplayer capabilities, allowing you to compete with friends and family. It has been tested and confirmed to be in working order, making it the perfect addition to any sports game collection.

This game is compatible with Sony PlayStation 2 consoles and has a rating of E-Everyone. The unit type is a single unit, and it was manufactured in NTSC-U/C (US/Canada) region code. The game was released in 2006 by MLB, and it comes with no manufacturer warranty. Get ready to take on the field and play in this exciting baseball game series.
